description:
List Kuchi's copy-paste Remotion video components: animated text and kinetic type, captions, AI-input and UI screens, cursors, logos, scenes and transitions. It is the set on https://kuchi.kalarislabs.com/components, read from the latest published registry.

Returns one page of components, each with its name, title, what it animates, category, npm and Kuchi dependencies, files, registry URL and shadcn install command, plus every category with its count. Filter by keywords or category. Shared library code that components build on is left out unless category="library". Use kuchi_get_component for one component's source.

Use it while building a remake, to find a ready-made component for a shot before writing one from scratch.

category.description: Exact category, e.g. 'text', 'scenes', 'screens', 'ai-input', 'captions', 'cursor', 'logos' or 'library'; the result lists them all

query.description: Keywords matched against names, titles and descriptions, e.g. 'typewriter', 'captions', 'chat prompt'

response_format.description: 'markdown' (default) for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: kuchi_list_components
title: List video components
